items.t: How Much Further Could Cipher Digital Stock Fall?
items.sum: Cipher Digital stock lost 28.4% in the month to Tuesday, November 24. The S&P 500 fell 6.1% over the same month. Its latest close is 81.1% below its highest close of the past year. If a market sell-off came on top of this fall, how much more could the stock lose, and for how long.
